newsitem.title: CANADA: Freeport sees Indonesia announcement soon. [corrected 19:50 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Freeport sees Indonesia announcement soon. [corrected 19:50 gmt]

text.p: (Corrects throughout to show that Indonesia, not company, will make an announcement.)

Freeport-McMoRan Copper and Gold Inc said on Friday it would not comment on rumors that it signed a memorandum of understanding with Bre-X Minerals Ltd, but said an announcement would be made by Indonesia in Jakarta next week.
A company spokeswoman said the announcement would come from Indonesia, but she would not elaborate on what the announcement would involve.
"We have no information we can share with you at this time," said spokeswoman Kristen Lemkau in a phone interview from New Orleans. She would not deny or confirm the rumors.
Published reports said Bre-X signed a memorandum of understanding with its Indonesian partners and Freeport McMoRan to develop the huge Busang gold deposit.
The deal would freeze out Canadian gold powerhouses Barrick Gold Corp and Placer Dome Inc, which both presented plans to operate Busang.
Neither Barrick nor Placer was immediately available for comment.
A spokesman for mining house RTZ Corp Plc -CRA Ltd in London would not comment on rumors that the company was involved in a deal with Freeport and Bre-X.
"We don't comment on market speculation," spokesman Fraser Hardie said in an interview from London.
"I think it's fairly unlikely we will have a comment," he said.
A spokesman for Bre-X also declined to confirm or deny the reports.
"Any announcements will come out of Indonesia," the spokesman said in a phone interview from New York. He said the reports were full of rumors and unnamed sources.
The rumors sent Bre-X and Barrick shares into a swirl on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
"The concern right now in the marketplace is that Bre-X is nailed to the wall," one gold analyst said.
"We don't know if it's a good deal for Bre-X. We don't know the terms. We don't know if it's true. We just have no idea."

Bre-X shares dropped C$1.50 to C$23.15 with 2.3 million shares trading hands in the first hour of trading. Barrick was down C$1.15 to C$35.50 on the Toronto Stock Exchange. In New York, the stock was off 5/8 to US$26 3/8.
Placer Dome was up C$0.25 to C$28.25 in light trading. In New York, Placer was up 1/4 to US$20 7/8.
